name: BN4's tables by the shapes BN5's were found by
result: tools/rom_tables.py found its map and coordinate tables; a song-header scan found its song table and, as the control, BN5's at its known 0x155BF4; Cannon's codes at a 0x2C stride found its chip records and, as the control, BN5's record 1 (0x01E23C); its text spells letters as BN6's (Cannon, Mettaur found); every map of groups 0x80-0x88 drew whole in a Python copy of area_src.c's reader; tools/bn6f_match.py with BN4 in BN5's place located 1,650 functions and none of bn6f's RAM labels at Falzar's addresses.
meaning: BN4's data travels into BN6 as BN5's did (maps, songs, names, chip records in BN6's size); its code is further from BN6's than BN5's, so each transplant pairs more of its engine first.
